result.markdown:
# Extended Transport Outage Following Fiber Maintenance in Sahel

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Maintenance window explains the start, but the outage extended 189 minutes beyond the window completion without direct alarm logs explaining the delay.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 09:15 to 2026-09-28 15:15
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 09:21
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011

## Summary

Transport link degradation or failure following planned maintenance caused sites to remain offline for over three hours after the window closed.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in Sahel for six hours due to extended transport disruption.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 09:15: Traffic and availability drop anomaly starts on three sites. [ALR-0035]
- 2026-09-28 09:21: Planned fiber splice work maintenance window MW-0013 begins on LNK-SAH-01-B. [MW-0013]
- 2026-09-28 09:29: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011, and S-SAH-005. [ALM-000487, ALM-000488, ALM-000489]
- 2026-09-28 11:56: Maintenance window MW-0013 completed on LNK-SAH-01-B. [MW-0013]
- 2026-09-28 15:05: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011, and S-SAH-005. [ALM-000487, ALM-000488, ALM-000489]
- 2026-09-28 15:15: Anomaly ALR-0035 ended after full site recovery. [ALR-0035]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in SAH (S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011) for 6 hours. [ALR-0035]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms occurred on S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, and S-SAH-011 starting at 2026-09-28 09:29. [T2, ALM-000487, ALM-000488, ALM-000489]
- No configuration changes were made on S-SAH-005, S-SAH-006, S-SAH-011 and their parents between 2026-09-28 08:00 and 16:00. [T3]
- Maintenance window MW-0013 ran on shared parent link LNK-SAH-01-B from 09:21 to 11:56. [MW-0013, T8]
- All affected sites depend on the shared fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B. [T5, T6, T7]
- No external events were recorded for region SAH during the incident window. [T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Transport link issues or delayed link recovery caused the outage to persist for 189 minutes after the maintenance window closed. [MW-0013, ALM-000487]
2. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SAH-01-B: rejected. The outage lasted until 15:05, which is 189 minutes after the maintenance window closed, making it an unplanned incident. [MW-0013, ALM-000487]
3. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were found on the affected sites or their parents during the relevant window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T3: No configuration changes occurred on the affected sites or their ancestor nodes during the window.
- T9: External events check returned no relevant events for the region.

## Recommended actions

- Investigate why transport link LNK-SAH-01-B kept sites offline for 189 minutes after MW-0013 completion.
- Verify post-maintenance fiber attenuation levels on LNK-SAH-01-B.
- Review procedures for verifying site connectivity following splice work.

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SAH-01-B that ended 187 min before service returned; it explains only the first part of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; The sites of LNK-SAH-01-B went down inside the maintenance window on LNK-SAH-01-B and stayed down 187 min after it closed: the part inside the window is planned work, the remainder is an unplanned outage and is labelled an incident. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the start of the outage (LNK-SAH-01-B), but the outage runs hours past its end. Settled by: (1) the outage continues 187 min after the window ends, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN stay active after the window closed instead of clearing with the end of the works.
